notes.fileMtimeMs: A comparison rule, applied to both sides: a step's `fileMtimeMs` (only on a writeProjectFile that succeeded) is not compared; the replay removes it from Node's step and from the core's before comparing (benchmarks/rust-core/recorders/lib/phone-files-replay.mjs:221-222). It is the mtime the answer carried, which the operating system stamps at the write (Node: apps/desktop/src/main/project-files.ts:407 `handle.stat()` after the rewrite, :601 `stat(file)` after the write), so it differs between any two runs, of Node as of the core. It is checked independently on each side instead: `play` (benchmarks/rust-core/recorders/lib/phone-files-script.mjs:426-427) fails the run unless the answer's mtimeMs equals the written file's mtime on disk right after the call, and the answer keeps `{$fileMtime: true}` in its place, which is compared; every other field of the step is compared as recorded.
